name: Mpox
value: UK 298 clade Ib cases to 31 Oct (UKHSA)
summary: Clade I mpox keeps spreading outside Africa; UKHSA counts 298 UK clade Ib cases; no new emergency declared
state: UKHSA's overview of 12 Nov counts 298 confirmed UK clade Ib cases to 31 Oct, with clade Ib overtaking clade IIb since July (UKHSA). Santé publique France's bulletin to 30 Sep also reports clade I cases in France, and ECDC counted clade I cases in 15 EU/EEA countries in October. Searches on 20 Nov found no new emergency of international concern, so clade I spread outside Africa keeps Watch.
for_you: Risk to the general public is low. People with close or sexual contact with cases are most exposed; UKHSA and the NHS publish vaccine eligibility and symptom advice.
rubric_hit: Watch: clade I spreading outside Africa (UK 298 clade Ib cases; EU/EEA cases); no PHEIC with accelerating growth
